name: prestashopheaven/build-testing-js
description: JavaScript test doubles of the PrestaHaven modules for Vitest: window.prestashop, jQuery, the admin components, runScript and the setup file that resets listeners and globals after every test, with TypeScript types.

prestashopheaven.use-when: A module has JavaScript or TypeScript tests in _dev/tests (Vitest + jsdom): import the PrestaShop test doubles and use the shared setup file instead of copying _dev/tests/support.
